title: Rivian's 2027 changes include its No. 1 most-requested feature
gist: Rivian's model year 2027 R1 update holds base prices flat at $79,990 (R1T) and $83,990 (R1S) and leaves powertrain and range specs unchanged, instead monetizing its most-requested customer feature — second-row captain's chairs at $1,500 to $4,500 — and aligning R1 trim naming with the newer R2.

themes.theme: Pricing held flat, revenue moved to options

insights.claim: Rivian kept model year 2027 base prices unchanged at $79,990 for the R1T pickup and $83,990 for the R1S SUV despite the trim restructuring and new features.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: Flat headline pricing in a year of rising device and vehicle costs suggests Rivian is defending volume rather than pushing ASP through sticker price.
insights.quote: But the base price for each stays the same: The R1T still starts at $79,990 and the R1S at $83,990.
insights.locator: Rivian has also changed the trims

insights.claim: Captain's chairs cost $1,500 on top of a required $2,500 Sound+Vision package, or $4,500 with the Ocean Coast interior — so Rivian's most-requested feature effectively carries a $4,000 minimum entry cost.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: Bundling the top-requested feature behind a mandatory package is a classic ASP-lift mechanism that raises transaction price without touching MSRP.
insights.quote: Captain's chairs add $1,500 on top of the required $2,500 Sound+Vision package, or $4,500 if you want the Ocean Coast interior
insights.locator: And you still have a choice of the same two interiors

insights.claim: On Performance and Quad R1 models the bench seat is only available with the black interior, while Ocean Coast ($4,000) and Slate Sky ($4,500) interiors are offered exclusively in the six-seat captain's chair configuration.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: Forcing the premium option on higher interior trims raises attach rate mechanically — watch Rivian's per-unit revenue rather than delivery counts.
insights.locator: The Performance R1s feature Rivian's tri-motor powertrain

insights.claim: Rivian is applying its recently released R2 SUV's offer structure to the larger R1 line, replacing Dual, Tri and R1s trim names with Premium and Performance while retaining Quad.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: Naming and configuration convergence across R1 and R2 lowers marketing and dealer-training complexity as Rivian scales into the mass-market segment.
insights.locator: Rivian has also changed the trims

insights.claim: Captain's chairs for the second row were the number one most requested feature by Rivian R1S customers, per the automaker, and the design includes a hidden cupholder and spacing that eases third-row access or carrying skis and boards between the seats.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: Direct evidence that three-row SUV buyers prioritize seating configuration over range or power — a demand signal for the whole electric SUV segment.
insights.locator: But among them is the No. 1 most requested feature

insights.claim: Rivian left R1 technical specs unchanged for 2027: Premium models keep 329 miles of range with an optional larger battery reaching 410 miles (R1S) and 420 miles (R1T), and power stays at 533 hp upgradable to 655 hp.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: No range or powertrain improvement in a model year suggests Rivian's engineering resources are committed to R2 volume ramp rather than R1 iteration.
insights.quote: But the technical specs haven't changed.
insights.locator: But the technical specs haven't changed

insights.claim: Performance R1s retain the tri-motor powertrain at 850 hp with 371 miles of range, and R1 Quads keep identical powertrain specs, meaning the entire 2027 refresh is cosmetic and configurational.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: A spec-frozen model year reduces engineering and validation cost, supporting gross margin while the platform matures.
insights.locator: The Performance R1s feature Rivian's tri-motor powertrain

insights.claim: The R1 line last received substantive changes in the 2024 refresh, which gave the R1S and R1T new powertrain options, a new electronic architecture and new batteries — making 2027 a low-investment carryover year.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: Two-to-three year cadence between major EV re-engineering cycles is the practical rhythm for a capital-constrained EV startup.

insights.claim: Minor 2027 additions include a new Esker silver paint replacing LA Silver and a new 20-inch all-season tire and wheel for the R1T aimed at balancing on- and off-road performance.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: Cosmetic-only updates confirm the model year is a placeholder ahead of the next platform investment.
insights.locator: Additionally, there's a new Esker silver paint
